sources.wikidata_ids: https://www.wikidata.org (searched individually per party via wbsearchentities/full-text search API; verified 2026-09-14 with direct item fetches, notably distinguishing alliance items from party items)

note: Morawiecki II government (confirmed via ParlGov cabinet-parties) = PiS alone. PiS's 235 seats and PO's 134 seats are reported as single blocs per ParlGov (which does not break out the small allied micro-parties Solidarna Polska/Porozumienie within PiS's list, or the Greens/Nowoczesna within PO's list) - this matches near-universal reporting convention for these two blocs. SLD (24), Wiosna (19) and Lewica Razem (6) are ParlGov's individual-seat breakdown of the 'Lewica' alliance (49 seats combined) - re-verified directly against the raw ParlGov election page (parlgov.fly.dev), which lists WIO=19 and LR=6 as sub-rows of the SLD coalition row, confirming these are correct and not swapped with an earlier Wikipedia-derived guess of SLD=23/Wiosna=15. PSL (20) and Kukiz'15 (6) are the breakdown of the 'Polish Coalition' (26 seats combined, plus 3 independents/1 other not separately itemized here); KORWIN (5) and National Movement (5) are the breakdown of 'Confederation' (11 seats combined, plus 1 one-seat entry not separately itemized). Party row 'Civic Coalition (PO)' was corrected on 2026-09-14 to use the Wikidata item for the KO electoral alliance (Q1021144, 'Civic Coalition', description 'liberal electoral alliance in Poland') instead of the previously-used Civic Platform party item (Q156868, description 'political party in Poland') - correct because this row's 134 seats represent the whole alliance, not just PO's own MPs.
